note: lint MissingSuperCall 說明頁支持必須呼叫 super;SuperNotCalledException 字樣頁面未出現,但規則本體相符。

note: 另一頁寫 'The destination needs to be annotated with @Serializable in order for Navigation library to convert the class or object'。兩條主張都有原文。

note: 官方頁 Caution:手動 setGraph() 時不要用 app:navGraph,'ensuring that setGraph() is called only once ... rather than multiple times',與型錄一致。

quote: ViewModel classes should never point to Views or non-application Contexts.
note: 同頁寫 'A static field will leak contexts.' 與 'direct field references to activities and fragments from these longer running instances can cause leaks.'。

quote: Since this Handler is declared as an inner class, it may prevent the outer class from being garbage collected.
note: HandlerLeak 說明頁直接支持。

quote: will leak the Context and prevent its memory from being properly reclaimed.

note: 原句後半 'if the context is not the application context.',與型錄(舊版洩漏、用 applicationContext)一致。

quote: In Android U, all receivers registering for non-system broadcasts are required to include a flag indicating the receiver's
note: 頁面後續說用 ContextCompat#registerReceiver 搭配 RECEIVER_EXPORTED 或 RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED;'丟例外' 細節未逐字見到。

quote: Views shouldn't directly trigger any coroutines to perform business logic.
note: 同頁說明由 ViewModel 啟動才好測、且 viewModelScope 的協程可自動撐過設定變更,lifecycleScope 則要手動處理,涵蓋旋轉取消與測試性後果。

note: 官方協程最佳實務頁,與 getModelStream 命名慣例(建議頁 Naming streams of data)一致。

note: 原句後接 Context。UI 層頁示範 UiState 為純資料(String、Boolean 等);lint 頁寫 ViewModel 不該指向 View 或非 application Context。Drawable 不可序列化那一點頁面未逐字提到,但主旨一致。

quote: Use Navigation 3 to navigate between screens and deep link to your app if your app has more than one screen.
note: 建議頁標為 Strongly recommended 'Use a single-activity application'。注意官方現行建議指向 Navigation 3,型錄寫 Navigation Compose / NavHostFragment 不衝突,可補提 Navigation 3。

quote: Scoping a binding to a component can be costly because the provided object stays in memory until that component is destroyed. Minimize the use of scoped bindings in your application.
note: 同段說明適用情境:有內部狀態、需同步、或量測過建立成本高;與型錄一致。

quote: It indicates when members injected values can be used (e.g. when `@Inject` fields are not null).

note: 官方 Hilt 頁範例即為兩個 OkHttpClient 用限定詞區分,與型錄一致。

quote: If a single instance needs to be shared across various ViewModels, then it should be scoped using either `@ActivityRetainedScoped` or `@Singleton`.
note: 同頁另寫 'Other instances of a ViewModel that request the scoped instance will receive a different instance.'。

note: 標準寫法有原文。型錄標示的 '實際錯誤形式待查' 官方頁未說明,仍屬待查。

note: 官方頁並舉例 SingletonComponent 用 fromApplication、ActivityComponent 改用 ActivityContext;與型錄一致。
